chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from al-Ḥasan ibn Mūsā al-Khashshāb, from Ghiyāth ibn Kallūb, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, that ʿAlī عليه السلام used to say:
Whoever misses the fasting of the three days that are during hajj, then let him fast them during the Days of Tashrīq, for that is permissible for him.

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ: the Days of Tashrīq following ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā, mentioned here as a permissible time to make up the fast
key_terms.الثَّلَاثَةِ الْأَيَّامِ: the three prescribed days of fasting connected to hajj
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: the pilgrimage context in which this fasting obligation applies
key_terms.صِيَامُ: fasting as a ritual act of worship
key_terms.فَاتَهُ: he missed or failed to perform within its original time

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to fast the three missed days of hajj during the Days of Tashrīq?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who must fast three days in hajj and misses them at their usual time. It states that fasting those missed days during the Days of Tashrīq is permissible for such a person.
